title: Ride the Trend
briefing: Nimbus Cloud is making higher highs and higher lows. Ride the trend, and get out when it breaks.
objective: Trade with the trend while it lasts. A break of the trendline and a lower high is the warning to leave.
debrief: Nimbus Cloud climbed in a clear uptrend for 24 days, with each dip stopping above the last. On day 24 a survey showing slower cloud spending broke the trend: the stock gapped down and made lower highs from then on. Players who held through the uptrend and left after the break kept most of the climb; buy-and-hold gave much of it back.

news.headline: Cloud spending slows, says industry survey
news.body: A survey of large companies finds they plan to spend less on cloud services next year.
